capability_negotiation_full.description: Full client (elicitation+sampling declared): confirm server capabilities before relying on them, browse resources/prompts pre-auth.

capability_negotiation_read_only.description: Read-only client (no elicitation/sampling declared): deploy_to_production and draft_incident_summary must stay hidden from tools/list even for a senior engineer; check_deployment_status is the mandated fallback; calling deploy_to_production directly anyway is rejected cleanly with ERR_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED.

defensive_and_authorization.description: Missing required field, disallowed extra field, an unauthenticated write, an unauthorized (junior) write, and an inactive engineer's access code — the server must reject all five.

notifications_on_promotion.description: Authenticate as junior (read-only tools + run_pre_deploy_checks appear), then re-authenticate as senior on the SAME connection (write tools + list_feature_flags appear) — tools/list_changed fires both times, no reconnect.

uncontrolled_deploy.description: PR 1 is Approved with a Passed scan, deployed to staging — completes immediately, no elicitation.

controlled_deploy_scan_not_passed.description: PR 2 is Approved but its latest scan is Failed; deploying to production triggers elicitation under rule (a). The engineer accepts, so the deploy proceeds with a recorded confirmation note.

controlled_deploy_unreviewed_declined.description: PR 3 is still Open (not reviewed); deploying it anywhere triggers elicitation under rule (b), regardless of environment. This time the engineer declines, so no deployment is created.

progress_pre_deploy_checks.description: run_pre_deploy_checks walks unit tests, integration tests, then a fresh security scan for PR 3, reporting progress after each stage instead of one blocking response.

sampling_incident_summary.description: draft_incident_summary asks the CLIENT's own model to draft a plain-language summary of the seeded critical incident via sampling/createMessage.

merge_and_rollback.description: merge_pull_request succeeds for an Approved+Passed PR and is refused for a still-Open one; rollback_deployment succeeds once and is refused on a second attempt against the same now-RolledBack deployment.
merge_and_rollback.rollback_reason: Elevated error rate observed in payments-service staging after this deploy; rolling back pending investigation.
